title: Human Sexuality
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Taught with a trusted adult always named and in the school's own agreed words for body changes; a CRE teacher and the school counsellor read this file first.

skills.key_step: The child names normal changes of adolescence in boys and girls, ways to cope (hygiene, asking a trusted adult, rest), tells healthy friendships (open, respectful, parents know) from unhealthy ones (secret, gifts for favours, pressure), and says 1 Corinthians 6:18-19 guides Christians to honour God with the body.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the body is a temple of the Holy Spirit.
floor.question: What does 1 Corinthians 6:19 call your body?
floor.answer: A temple of the Holy Spirit

representations: two columns: healthy and unhealthy friendship
steps: Healthy friendships are open and respectful.
Secret gifts and pressure are warning signs: tell.
contexts: an older person giving secret gifts

board.do: Draw two columns: healthy and unhealthy.
Point at the card "keeps it secret from parents".
board.say: Which column does this go in?

board.do: Wait for the child to say unhealthy.
Write whom to tell at the bottom.

misconceptions.ask: How should a child feel about the changes of adolescence?
misconceptions.repair: Say that all adults went through the same changes.

listen_for: From friends and anything on the internet
misconceptions.ask: Where is the best place to find the right information about growing up?
misconceptions.repair: Compare a friend's guess with a nurse's answer.

listen_for: The friend says to keep it secret and gives gifts for favours
misconceptions.ask: Which is a sign of an unhealthy friendship?
misconceptions.repair: List warning signs: secrecy, pressure, gifts for favours.

misconceptions.ask: Which change usually happens in girls at adolescence?

checks.question: Are the changes of adolescence shameful?
checks.answer: No: they are normal; ask a trusted adult

checks.question: Name a sign of an unhealthy friendship.
